evidence: On the initial paths, if either of two state/context checks succeeds, tail-calls the accepted wait_for_attribute_context_entry_processing helper. Otherwise it reads context status selector 0x13, initializes temporary state, queries additional context helpers, and conditionally invokes a follow-up handler. The caller invokes this helper after its own predicate succeeds. Label describes the observed prepare-or-wait role without assigning a domain name to the temporary state. Full body: decompiled/main/main_0054.c:10390-10496; caller: decompiled/main/main_0058.c:11122-11126 (corrected during QA); wait helper annotation: tools/data/function_annotations.tsv:12147.

Clears each nonzero byte at record offsets +0x28,+0x30,+0x34,+0x38,+0x42,+0x4a,+0x4e,+0x62. If the nested block pointer at +0x68 is present, reads float values for nested IDs 0x1a,0x31,0x3a,0x43,0x46, negates each value, converts it to signed int, and passes the delta to add_attribute_delta_by_id. The indexed caller invokes this routine after accepted nested-entry predicates for selector IDs 1, 3, and 4. Full body: decompiled/main/main_0170.c:13104-13205; caller: decompiled/main/main_0170.c:55957-55988; helper annotations: tools/data/function_annotations.tsv (add_attribute_delta_by_id and nested_attribute_block_get_float).

Reads the current context entry, checks state/status selector 0x13 and selector 0x15 against entry state, and either returns or loops over up to eight selected records. For each selected entry it calls compute_player_attribute_context_value and related update helpers, then conditionally updates the corresponding context record. Its caller runs it in a sequence of player-attribute-context update helpers after confirming the entry state. Full body: decompiled/main/main_0092.c:14443-14549; caller: decompiled/main/main_0092.c:13608-13612; accepted computation helper: tools/data/function_annotations.tsv (0x7001877910).

Queries context status selector 0x15 to choose a mode flag, obtains counts for two groups, then scans the corresponding entries and calls player_attribute_get_float. Returns 1 immediately when a scanned float is nonzero; returns 0 after both scans find no nonzero value. Its indexed caller uses this boolean to choose a subsequent path. Full body: decompiled/main/main_0109.c:6107-6221; caller: decompiled/main/main_0109.c:5797-5801; getter annotation: tools/data/function_annotations.tsv (0x700183e8e0).

The body reads record values at +0x3a8,+0x3ac,+0x68 and +0x2ed4, invokes map_player_attribute_to_rating_bucket plus numerous unresolved conversion/dispatch helpers, and builds several temporary derived values before dispatching through fields in the record. No indexed caller is available, and the destination/value meanings are not established well enough to name the whole routine. Full body: decompiled/main/main_0113.c:23311-23427; accepted helper: tools/data/function_annotations.tsv (0x7000fecc90).
